editorialCorrections.change: Confirmed usual colon orientation with NCI. Kept massage suitability boundaries separate from anatomy. CUH lists pregnancy, inflammatory bowel disease, malignant obstruction, recent scarring/surgery and other exclusions; not a universal self-screen. Suspected obstruction/unknown pain prompt professional assessment, no treatment instructions.

Fresh NCI definitions distinguish scrotum/testis/foreskin. Source195 male action still lacks specialist interpretation. No pulling/retraction/washing action supplied; technical uncertainty retained visibly.

Replaced unrelated legacy anatomy/hygiene distractors with distinct alternatives testing each actual learning goal. Original7IDs/day mapping/correct indices preserved. Japanese question scenes independently expressed, all self-contained, readingJa empty.
Moved editorial approval status into metadata/report; retained actual learning limits and source195 uncertainty in natural Japanese prose. No internal hashes or source paths in reader.

Root editorial read caught ambiguous diagram-relative right/left. Revised the anatomy-reading sentence to explicitly use the person’s lower-right/upper-right/left/lower-left, never the viewer’s right. Still expressly not a massage protocol.
